Good morning Muna, we have now reviewed the apartment. 

Below is a photo of all the items we do not need. If you can arrange collection please and remove or a note on the inventory.

Please can the broken table on balcony be removed.

The guest bathroom shower head is away from wall. It's fine but needs noting.

The second bedroom is missing a light fixture. Please can this be fixed. 

We are also missing one remote for the guest Television.

Can you also send me a copy of the signed inventory.

Thanks
